# lcd.resetFocusTimeout

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.1</span></div>

Reset the 10s focus timeout on Home screen.

```lua
lcd.resetFocusTimeout()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.
